title: Help request settings
lead: Safety switches and limits for the automatic helper search. Nothing here moves money.
saveFailed: Settings were not saved. Check the highlighted fields and try again.

enabled.label: Automatic help is on
enabled.help: When off, no new help requests are created.

dryRun.label: Dry run (preview only)
dryRun.help: The system only records what it would do. Nobody is messaged.

claimTimeout.label: Minutes before a claim reopens
claimTimeout.help: If a helper says yes and does not finish in this time, the request reopens for others.

cooldown.label: Cooldown (minutes)
cooldown.help: Wait before asking the same shop again.

dailyCap.label: Requests per shop per day
dailyCap.help: Stops one shop from being asked too often.

perWave.label: Helpers asked per wave
perWave.help: How many helpers each wave contacts at once.

horizon.label: Look-ahead (hours)
horizon.help: How far ahead to check for a shortage.

buffer.label: Safety buffer (%)
buffer.help: Extra money added on top of the shortfall.

minShortfall.label: Smallest shortfall (৳)
minShortfall.help: Smaller gaps are not worth a request.

maxRequest.label: Largest request (৳)
maxRequest.help: Caps the amount of one request.

leadMargin.label: Lead time (hours)
leadMargin.help: Ask at least this long before the shortage hits.

radius.label: Search radius (km)
radius.help: Helpers must be within this distance.

maxWaves.label: Number of waves
maxWaves.help: How many rounds of helpers are asked before the distributor is told.

waveTimeout.label: Minutes per wave
waveTimeout.help: How long a wave has to answer before the next one starts.

recentAsk.label: Do not ask again within (hours)
recentAsk.help: Stops repeated asks for the same shop.

deadlineFloor.label: Shortest deadline (minutes)
deadlineFloor.help: A request never asks for help sooner than this. Stock-out within twice this time marks it urgent.

urgentWave.label: Urgent first wave (times)
urgentWave.help: Urgent requests ask this many times more agents in the first wave.

lateGrace.label: Late confirm window (hours)
lateGrace.help: After a request expires, the requester side can still confirm a late delivery from the helper whose acceptance timed out, for this long.

perTick.label: New requests per run
perTick.help: At most this many new requests per scheduler run, most urgent first. The rest wait for the next runs.

range: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

preview.title: Dry-run preview
preview.lead: Shows who would get a request right now. Sends nothing.
preview.empty: Nothing would be requested right now.
preview.failed: The preview could not run. Try again.

demo.title: Simulate a shortage
demo.lead: Demo only. Forces one shop short for 30 minutes and runs the helper search now. Results are marked as simulated.
demo.none: No request was created for that shop.
demo.dryRun: Dry run is ON: nothing was sent. {{n}} people would have been asked.
demo.switchedOff: Help requests are switched off: nothing was sent. {{n}} people would have been asked.

blocked.active_request: Already has an open request for that float.

demoMode.title: Demo mode
demoMode.lead: Demo defaults below; your saved values win.
demoMode.autoCap: Auto requests: max {{n}} per shop and float a day.
demoMode.startDelay: First check waits {{n}} s after a fresh start.
demoMode.resetBody: Cancels demo shops' open requests and restarts their limits. Nobody is messaged. Audited.

scheduler.title: Background check
scheduler.lead: Runs every minute: new requests, next waves, timeouts.
scheduler.stale: No recent run: the check may be down.

wouldAsk.dryRun: Dry run is ON: nothing was sent.
wouldAsk.off: Help requests are off: nothing was sent.
